source_text: Οὐαὶ τοίνυν ὑμῖν, ὦ νομικοί, ὅτι φορτικὸν ὁμολογουμένως ὄντα τὸν νόμον τοῖς μὲν ἄλλοις πατοῦσιν αὐτὸν θανάτου δίκην ἐπάγετε, αὐτοὶ δὲ τοῦ νόμου οὐδὲ προσψαύετε.
pass_a_gloss: Woe therefore to you, O lawyers, that burdensome admittedly being the law to the on-the-one-hand others trampling it of death penalty you-bring, yourselves but of the law not-even you-touch.
pass_b_english: Woe to you, then, lawyers: while the law is admittedly burdensome, on others who trample it you bring the penalty of death, but you yourselves do not even touch the law.
